name: Insurance Scheme for the Construction Workers
briefDescription: This scheme, by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, enrolls construction workers in Dadra Nagar Haveli and Daman Diu under two national insurance yojnas.
descriptionMd: The "Insurance Scheme for the Construction Workers" is a welfare initiative by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, U.T. Administration of DNH & DD. It aims to provide social security and financial protection to construction workers by enrolling them in national insurance programs.
benefitsMd:
*   Enrollment under Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojna (PMSBY).
*   Enrollment under Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojna (PMJJBY).
eligibilityMd:
*   Must be a construction worker.
*   Must be eligible for Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojna.
*   Must be eligible for Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojna.
*   Must fall under the jurisdiction of the U.T. Administration of Dadra Nagar Haveli and Daman Diu.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
